scientific_integrity: Self-contained noncancellation and moving-knot argument; the established simplex-spline formula is acknowledged as prior work. Exact-rational checks are supporting illustrations and not an exhaustive universal certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only full-dimensional convex polytopes in Euclidean dimensions at least two; exact finite separated rank, not numerical approximate rank. Existence of an equivalent prior unindexed assertion remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Infinite near-support separation rank of polytope section profiles
